title: Onboard elysian-11b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Onboard elysian-11b v1.0 into the model registry. This PR adds canonical metadata, model card, and a set of performance profiles for common sequence-length buckets. It also wires the model onboarding machinery into the changelog/release-notes automation so new model entries generate a draft changelog entry automatically for product/marketing review. Motivation: elysian is a high-quality 11B model that our customers requested for chat and code-assist workloads. We need validated perf profiles and a changelog entry to make the model visible on the public catalog and to enable controlled rollouts. What changed: - models/elysian-11b/v1.0/metadata.yaml: model card (owners, license, tokenizer, recommended configs). - models/elysian-11b/v1.0/perf_profiles.yaml: perf measurements across batch sizes and seq lengths, single-GPU and multi-GPU profiles, numeric metrics (p50/p95 latencies, throughput, memory headroom). - docs/models/elysian-11b.md: user-facing model page summarizing capabilities, recommended use-cases, and knob recommendations (quantization/kv-cache hints). - scripts/automate_changelog.py: extend automation to include a template for model-onboard entries with perf highlights and a link back to the model metadata. - changelogs/auto_changelog_entries/elysian-11b-v1.0.md: auto-generated draft entry included for release manager review. - tests/test_perf_profiles.py: unit tests validate profile schema, value ranges and CI gating for perf anomalies. Checklist: - [x] metadata.yaml created and validated against schema - [x] perf_profiles.yaml measured and uploaded to artifact storage - [x] docs page drafted - [x] changelog automation extended and draft entry generated - [x] tests added and passing in CI Notes: Perf numbers are derived from internal perf lab runs (bench-run-id: bench-2024-11-12-elysian). We marked the default recommended profile as single-GPU fp16 with kv-cache enabled; multi-GPU configs exist but are marked 'experimental' until more production traffic validates cost/latency tradeoffs. Follow-ups: - follow-up ticket to add quantization sweep (ENG-4893) - add an e2e smoke test for inference on Dedicated (PM-804).
